description: This is a PHP unit test class 'SkillDaoTest' that tests the functionality of the 'SkillDao' data access object within the OrangeHRM administrative plugin. It includes setup, CRUD operation tests, search functionality tests, and verifies behavior of methods related to Skill entities.

classes.name: SkillDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the SkillDao data access object in OrangeHRM, focusing on skill retrieval, deletion, search, saving, and updating.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the SkillDao instance, sets up fixture files, and populates test data before each test.

methods.name: testGetSkillById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a skill by its ID and asserts the skill's name and description.

methods.name: testDeleteSkill
methods.description: Tests deleting skills by IDs and verifies the number of deleted records.

methods.name: testSearchSkill
methods.description: Tests searching for skills with default filter parameters and asserts the number and type of results.

methods.name: testSearchSkillWithLimit
methods.description: Tests searching for skills with a specified limit parameter.

methods.name: testSaveSkill
methods.description: Tests saving a new skill entity and checks if the saved skill has the expected name and description.

methods.name: testEditSkill
methods.description: Tests editing an existing skill and verifies the updated name, description, and ID.

methods.name: testGetSearchSkillsCount
methods.description: Tests counting the total number of skills matching search parameters.
